Home.loose_stories: Casual stories from programmers lifes and practical knowledge in an easy form.
Home.about: We create light-hearted, humorous approach to programming. We talk about bugs that cost hours of debugging, successes after endless fixes, but most importantly we share experiences in a light, accessible way.
Home.q1: Do I have to be a programmer to join the community?
Home.a1: No, but there is a risk you will become one.
Home.q2: I code in PHP. Can I join?
Home.a2: Yes, but we will be watching you closely.
Home.q3: Do I have to pay to access the community?
Home.a3: No. But if you want to send coffee, our backend developer will be happy.
Home.q4: My code doesn't work, but there are no errors. Can you help me?
Home.a4: Sure, although the problem may be deeper. Probably the code is testing you, not you the code.
